paragraphs: The GLS580 is the flagship non-AMG petrol model in the GLS range, introduced with the X167 generation in 2019. It uses the M176 - a 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8 with mild-hybrid assistance, part of Mercedes' second-generation biturbo V8 family. The M176 delivers substantial power and torque while incorporating cylinder deactivation for improved efficiency. The GLS580 remains in production as of 2026.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every GLS580 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the GLS580 from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: Because the GLS580 uses a single engine family across the entire X167 generation, compatibility is relatively straightforward - but accurate matching still matters for ancillaries, ECU calibration, and year-specific revisions. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:
